claim: Native QUINATEDEG-PWY defines quinate → 3-dehydroquinate → 3-dehydroshikimate → protocatechuate. Primary genetic/extract results support ADP1 route. IFO3244 fractions support steps with explicit preparation limits; do not require one purified same-strain full reconstitution.

ADP1 QuiA genetic and cell-extract oxidation evidence; 809-aa sequence deposited U11554. Predicted membrane segments are sequence inference. E. coli DH5α(pZR504) lacks detectable standard-assay activity even with 12 nM PQQ, despite weak product color assay. No purified ADP1 PQQ-binding or acceptor-spectrum claim.

ADP1 native induction/deletion supports thermolabile catabolic QuiB. E. coli pZR554 complements aroD6. QuiC pZR564 crude extracts show DHS-dehydratase activity; native comment incorrectly names DHQ. Original QuiB290 aa differs current 272 aa; old leader hypothesis is not localization proof. Deposit U20284.
Catabolic ADP1 QuiB belongs to the type I family; native narrative that type I enzymes occur only biosynthetically is overgeneralized. Do not exclude QuiB or import unrelated biosynthetic AroD.

Acinetobacter sp. SA1 holo-QDH and PQQ-deficient Acinetobacter calcoaceticus AC3 apo-QDH purified; reconstitution uses PQQ plus calcium. Ferricyanide, PMS/DCIP, DCIP alone and ubiquinone 2 accepted. Membrane oxygen uptake supports respiratory coupling inference; no universal quinone assay, no PQQ net consumption. No ADP1 purification transfer.

IFO3244 cytoplasmic fraction contains separable DHS dehydratase, eluted at 0.225 M KCl after DQD at 0.2 M; PCA assessed by coupled qualitative color assay. Retain unnamed native protein, partial purification; no sequence/accession/oligomer inferred. NADP belongs to SKDH readout/biosynthetic branch, not DHS-dehydratase cofactor.

Native membrane-associated pDQD purified from IFO3244, gel filtration 191 kDa and SDS16 kDa suggest 12 subunits. Native molecular-weight-exp 189 kDa instead matches sDQD; do not copy. Periplasm/outer membrane-side topology inferred; no RSO/ISO test. QDH association/linker speculative.

Short N-terminal comparison uses 621H GOX0437, not IFO3244 whole-protein sequence. Figure 2C MKRPLITVLN conflicts with prose MKRRLITVLN. No exact cleavage endpoint/whole-sequence transfer; current Q5FTS6 is 621H.

bounds: abstract only, native enzyme/protein comments separately
claim: IFO3244 membrane holo-QDH purified;65/21 kDa bands may reflect single-chain proteolysis. Do not turn bands into obligate heterodimer or claim exact cleavage/full sequence. Body and electron-acceptor panel unread.
PQQ prosthetic cofactor differs from electron-accepting quinone substrate. ADP1 cofactor edge is supported as native/current UniProt annotation, not direct SA1 or LMD79.41 experiment.

No QuiX transport edge (function unestablished), no direct PCA regulator-binding edge (metabolic induction only), no obligatory QuiA–pDQD assembly, no added fungi/Gram-positive/NAD route, no biosynthetic sDQD/SKDH components, no engineered 2010/2021/2022 constructs transferred to native route.
